title: The Flight of Garuda: Beyond Fear
description: A POV experience as the divine eagle Lord Garuda, soaring from the earthly realm into the celestial heights where fear cannot reach.

scenes.visual_prompt: First-person POV from the back of a divine eagle deity, Lord Garuda. Massive golden-brown wings with shimmering emerald tips visible at the edges of the frame. Rising rapidly from a misty ancient Indian temple valley into the clouds. Cinematic sun rays piercing through feathers. Mythological fantasy style, hyper-detailed textures.
scenes.motion_prompt: Powerful upward surge with the rhythmic, slow flapping of massive wings appearing at the periphery.
scenes.narration: In the shadow of the earth, fear is heavy. But you were born for the sun.

scenes.visual_prompt: POV gliding through high-altitude golden clouds. The edges of the frame show Garuda’s powerful talons and a glimpse of a jeweled chest-plate (Kavacha) reflecting the sun. Below, the mountains look like tiny pebbles. The sky transitions from blue to a deep cosmic indigo. Divine glow, high contrast, surreal scale.
scenes.motion_prompt: Smooth, high-speed forward glide with slight banking to the left, clouds rushing past the viewer.
scenes.narration: As the world shrinks, so does the noise of the ego. Up here, there is no 'small' to worry about.

scenes.visual_prompt: Ultra-wide POV from extreme height. The horizon curves. Wisps of golden energy trail from Garuda's wings. The viewer sees the world through a divine lens—everything is bathed in a calm, amber light. No ground visible, only an endless ocean of clouds and stars. Sacred, majestic atmosphere.
scenes.motion_prompt: Steady, effortless hovering motion. The wings at the edges are now still, catching the celestial thermals.
scenes.narration: Fear lives in the details of the ground. Height offers the truth of the whole.

scenes.visual_prompt: POV looking directly into a massive, gentle sun that doesn't blind. A silhouette of Garuda’s eagle-like profile is briefly visible in a reflection. Feathers are glowing like molten gold. The atmosphere is one of absolute peace and cosmic power. Cinematic bloom, ethereal particles, divine fantasy.
scenes.motion_prompt: Slow vertical ascent toward the light, fading into a soft golden white-out.
scenes.narration: You are no longer the one who fears. You are the wings that carry the light. Fly higher.
